title: Grace Period and Reinstatement Charge for Renewing an Alignment Services & Plans Month-Based Plan
content:
**Grace period.** The grace period of a renewal of an expired Alignment Services & Plans month-based plan (Crestline 1-Year or 3-Year Alignment Plan) is anchored on the expired plan's service history. A renewal inside its grace period carries no reinstatement charge, and a renewal outside it carries the reinstatement charge of 20.00. The final stretch of the term is its final 6 whole calendar months: an alignment falls within it when fewer than 6 whole calendar months separate the alignment from the expiration date.

| Expired plan's service history | Grace period runs from | No reinstatement charge when the renewal comes | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|
| Its latest alignment included in the plan fell within the final stretch | that alignment | fewer than 7 whole calendar months after it | 20.00 |
| No included alignment, but an alignment at the member early price, fell within the final stretch | the latest such member-early alignment | fewer than 7 whole calendar months after it | 20.00 |
| Every other case | the expiration date | no more than 30 calendar days after it | 20.00 |

### Worked cases (hypothetical plan expiring on 30 April)
- Latest included alignment on 15 December (4 whole months before expiry, inside the stretch): a renewal on 14 July is 6 whole months after it — no charge; a renewal on 15 July is 7 — 20.00.
- Latest included alignment the previous August (8 whole months before expiry), member-early alignment on 1 February: grace runs from 1 February; a renewal on 31 August is 6 whole months after it — no charge.
- No alignment in the final stretch: a renewal on 30 May is 30 days after the expiration date — no charge; on 31 May — 20.00.
